newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's TA gets nod for S.Africa bank.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's TA gets nod for S.Africa bank.

text.p: Stockbroking and finance group TA Enterprise Bhd said on Monday it has received approval to establish and own a bank in South Africa.
The company said in a statement that it has received approval from the Registrar of Banks of South Africa to establish TA Bank of South Africa.
The venture would help TA to become a complete financial house in the emerging markets of South East Asia and South Africa, the statement said.
TA had revealed plans in July to open a bank in the Philippines by January 2 next year.
TA requires the approval of the Minister of Finance of South Africa before it could proceed with the venture.
